name: Yi-Coder-9B
notes: Release date 2024-09-05 verified from official 01-ai/Yi-Coder GitHub README News section ('2024-09-05: The Yi-Coder series models are open sourced'). 9B params, 128K context, 52 programming languages (Apache 2.0). NOTE: This is the LAST open-weight release from 01.AI — verified via multiple 2026 sources (presenc.ai Yi lineage: 'Yi-Coder (September 2024) is the latest open-weight coding model'; Yi-Lightning (2024-10-16) is API-only with no open weights; no open-weight release exists after Sept 2024 as of Aug 2026).
